official_facts.fact_zh: 二期配套项目已于2026-07公开完工；北段清华东路至北五环整体建设约30.01公顷，南段为配套工程。
official_facts.fact_en: Phase-2 supporting works were publicly reported complete in July 2026; the north section from Qinghuadonglu to the North Fifth Ring covers about 30.01 ha, with supporting works in the south.

official_facts.fact_zh: 一期公开资料确认恢复老京张正线、修复保留清华园站房，并利用旧铁轨、道岔、机车与火车转盘展示铁路文化。
official_facts.fact_en: Official Phase-1 reporting confirms the restored historic main line, retained Qinghuayuan station building, and reuse of rails, switches, locomotive and turntable elements.

official_facts.fact_zh: 2026完工资料确认京张之环、铁轨花园，以及铁轨、油罐车、汽笛互动装置和鱼骨状慢行网络。
official_facts.fact_en: The 2026 completion notice confirms the Jing-Zhang Ring, rail garden, rail/tank-car/whistle installations and a fishbone slow-mobility network.

official_facts.fact_zh: 官方回应确认13号线阻隔影响公园与周边大型社区联系，并在二期实施红线内北三环北侧就近设置出入口。
official_facts.fact_en: An official response confirms the Line-13 barrier and a nearby entrance north of the North Third Ring within the Phase-2 implementation boundary.

official_facts.fact_zh: 公开规划条件：更新单元北至街坊三路、东至13号线用地西边界、南至北三环、西至方恒广场；街坊二路不小于18米，四路/五路不小于15米，并要求与大钟寺站地上地下慢行衔接。
official_facts.fact_en: Public planning conditions place the renewal unit south of local street 3, west of Line-13 land, north of the North Third Ring and east of Fangheng Plaza; local street 2 is at least 18 m, streets 4/5 at least 15 m, with above/below-ground slow connection to Dazhongsi Station.
